items.name: Fatal
items.bestFor: Boss fights, heavy hits, and crit-focused damage builds.
items.stoneRoute: Random wand roll at the Sea of Oblivion enchanting table; spend 1 Enchanted Stone.
items.verificationNote: GAMES.GG lists Fatal at 5%, 15%, and 25% Critical Damage for tiers I, III, and V. No reliable individual enchantment image found.

items.name: Critical Hit
items.bestFor: Mob farming, multi-hit spell rotations, and builds that need more crit triggers.
items.stoneRoute: Random wand roll at the Sea of Oblivion enchanting table; spend 1 Enchanted Stone.
items.verificationNote: GAMES.GG lists Critical Hit at 5%, 15%, and 25% Crit Rate for tiers I, III, and V. No reliable individual enchantment image found.

items.name: Magic
items.bestFor: Fallback damage when an elemental or crit roll does not fit the current build.
items.stoneRoute: Random wand roll at the Sea of Oblivion enchanting table; spend 1 Enchanted Stone.
items.verificationNote: GAMES.GG lists Magic at 2%, 6%, and 10% Attack Boost for tiers I, III, and V, and calls it weaker than dedicated elemental options.

items.name: Blazing Fire
items.bestFor: Fire spell builds and players leaning into fire-based damage bonuses.
items.stoneRoute: Random wand roll at the Sea of Oblivion enchanting table; spend 1 Enchanted Stone.
items.verificationNote: GAMES.GG lists Blazing Fire at 8%, 24%, and 40% Fire Damage Boost and notes that its tier V value is higher than the other elemental boosts.

items.name: Thunder
items.bestFor: Thunder spell builds that want their element bonus on the wand roll.
items.stoneRoute: Random wand roll at the Sea of Oblivion enchanting table; spend 1 Enchanted Stone.
items.verificationNote: GAMES.GG lists Thunder at 4%, 12%, and 20% Thunder Damage Boost for tiers I, III, and V. No reliable individual enchantment image found.

items.name: Shadow
items.bestFor: Dark spell builds and Night Wraith-style damage routes.
items.stoneRoute: Random wand roll at the Sea of Oblivion enchanting table; spend 1 Enchanted Stone.
items.verificationNote: GAMES.GG lists Shadow at 4%, 12%, and 20% Dark Damage Boost for tiers I, III, and V. No reliable individual enchantment image found.

items.name: Ice
items.bestFor: Ice spell builds, Frost Thorns-style farming, and defensive ice setups.
items.stoneRoute: Random wand roll at the Sea of Oblivion enchanting table; spend 1 Enchanted Stone.
items.verificationNote: GAMES.GG lists Ice at 4%, 12%, and 20% Ice Damage Boost for tiers I, III, and V. No reliable individual enchantment image found.

items.name: Luck
items.bestFor: Potion crafting, rare material farming, and players chasing better alchemy outcomes.
items.stoneRoute: Random wand roll at the Sea of Oblivion enchanting table; spend 1 Enchanted Stone.
items.verificationNote: GAMES.GG lists Luck at 10%, 30%, and 50% Alchemy Luck Boost and describes it as strongest for crafting or rare material farming.

items.name: Swift
items.bestFor: Chest loops, stone farming routes, dodging, and long travel before a better broom route is comfortable.
items.stoneRoute: Random wand roll at the Sea of Oblivion enchanting table; spend 1 Enchanted Stone.
items.verificationNote: GAMES.GG lists Swift at 5%, 15%, and 25% Movement Speed Bonus for tiers I, III, and V. No reliable individual enchantment image found.

items.name: Staying Calm
items.bestFor: Spell-heavy farming loops where faster uptime matters more than one-hit burst.
items.stoneRoute: Random wand roll at the Sea of Oblivion enchanting table; spend 1 Enchanted Stone.
items.verificationNote: GAMES.GG lists Staying Calm at 10%, 30%, and 50% Cooling Shrinkage and frames it as a spell-uptime utility roll.
